description: This file defines the custom exception class PersonAttributeTypeLockedException, used within the org.openmrs.api package to indicate that person attribute types are locked and cannot be modified.

classes.name: PersonAttributeTypeLockedException
classes.description: A custom exception class that extends APIException to indicate when person attribute types are locked and cannot be manipulated.

methods.name: PersonAttributeTypeLockedException()
methods.description: Default constructor that sets a standard message indicating the attribute type is locked.

methods.name: PersonAttributeTypeLockedException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor allowing a custom message to be specified.

methods.name: PersonAttributeTypeLockedException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor allowing a custom message and a cause exception for chaining.

methods.name: PersonAttributeTypeLockedException(Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor allowing chaining with a parent exception without setting a custom message.
